narrative: 从一个高高在上的正式视角回到人体高度，或者把摄影机降低到一个孩子、一张桌子、一处伤口的高度。因为俯仰角保持不变，世界不会因此弯曲；我们只是站在了更低的位置上。
如果你必须在下降的同时向下看，或者臂架应该越过一道栏杆摆动，那么这就不是合适的工具。如果俯仰角发生了变化，那就已经不是垂直升降了。
how: 只在Y轴上做位移。保持俯仰角不变，通常也保持偏航角不变。
垂直视差与上升运动相反：建筑结构在画面中向上攀升。提示词：垂直下降，摄影机竖直降低，不改变俯仰角，沿同一条轴线平稳下降。
when: 用它在一个高高在上的正式视角之后回到人体高度。具体场景：从吊灯的高度下降到这对情侣的高度，视线始终平视舞厅，而不是向下看着地板。
不要通过俯仰角来把他们保持在画面中；应该通过改变高度来实现。
vs: 摇臂下降（Crane Down）可以画出弧线、向前推进，甚至衔接成一次步行。向下摇（Tilt Down）则是在固定高度上改变俯仰角。
垂直升起（Pedestal Up）是方向相反的同一种立柱运动。垂直下降则让摄影机降下来，同时视线方向保持不变。
examples_film: 《巴里·林登》（Barry Lyndon）偏好正式、节制的高度设置和固定的几何关系，而不是俯冲式的摇臂运动。《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）同样把垂直机位当作场景中的一个物理事实来处理。
把它们当作俯仰角锁定式下降的语法范本。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是向下摇，或者摇臂下降。破绽在于水平线发生俯仰晃动，或者路径在家具上方画出弧线。
解决办法：垂直的直线下降，俯仰角保持冻结，结束在新的视平线上。

faq.q: 电影中的垂直下降（Pedestal Down）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机沿垂直方向直线下降，俯仰角保持不变，使镜头处在一个更低的位置，而没有任何俯仰晃动。

faq.q: 垂直下降（Pedestal Down）与摇臂下降（Crane Down）的区别
faq.a: 摇臂下降沿着一条臂架移动，抵达时角度往往也会发生变化。垂直下降则是沿立柱的下降：俯仰角不变，只有高度发生变化。

faq.q: 什么时候该用垂直下降（Pedestal Down）？
faq.a: 当身份等级或尺度需要通过降低摄影机高度来改变，而不是通过向下看来改变时使用。不要用它从屋顶俯冲向一张脸。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写垂直下降（Pedestal Down）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：摄影机沿立柱竖直下降，俯仰角保持不变，没有弧线。并说明起始高度和最终落定的高度。

narrative: Return to human height after a high formal view, or sit the camera down to a child, a table, a wound. Because tilt is constant, the world does not bow; we simply stand lower in it.
It is the wrong tool when you must look down as you drop, or when the arm should swing over a railing. If pitch changes, you left the pedestal.
how: Translate on Y only. Keep tilt, and usually keep yaw.
Vertical parallax reverses the up-move: architecture climbs the frame. Prompt a pedestal down, camera lowering vertically, no tilt, a calm descent through the same axis.
when: Use it to return to human height after a high formal view. Concrete beat: from a chandelier's height down to the couple, still looking along the ballroom, not down at the floor.
Do not tilt to keep them in frame; change height instead.
vs: A Crane Down can arc, advance, and even hand off to a walk. A Tilt Down pitches from a fixed height.
Pedestal Up is the opposite column. Pedestal down sits the camera down while it keeps looking the same way.
examples_film: Barry Lyndon favors formal, measured height and locked geometry over swooping arms. 2001: A Space Odyssey again treats vertical station as a physical fact of the set.
Use them as tilt-locked descent grammar.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Tilt Down or Crane Down. The tell is a nodding horizon or a curved path over furniture.
The fix: straight drop, tilt frozen, end at the new eyeline.

faq.q: What is Pedestal Down in film?
faq.a: It is a straight vertical lowering of the camera with tilt unchanged, so the lens occupies a lower station without nodding.
Crane down travels on an arm and often changes angle as it arrives. Pedestal down is a column drop: same pitch, new height.

faq.q: When should I use Pedestal Down?
faq.a: When rank or scale should change by sitting the camera down, not by looking down. Do not use it to dive at a face from a rooftop.

faq.q: How do I prompt Pedestal Down for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write camera lowers straight down on a pedestal, tilt constant, no arc. Name the start height and the settle.
